Disposal of materials and components

How to properly dispose of the packaging and components.

On this page you will find information on the components and how to dispose of them correctly. You will find an overview below. Each test kit is listed there with its components and disposal instructions.

STI Basic

Box, envelope, band, and instructions for use

Material: PAP 22, PAP 21

Dispose of properly in paper recycling bins.

Urine Collection Set

Material: (PP) 05, (HDPE) 02, (PET) 01, (PE) 04
Dispose of properly in plastic recycling bins.

Alcohol swabs

Material: (Viscose/Cotton: not coded), (PP) 05, (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in residual waste bins. Packaging can be disposed of in plastic recycling bins.

STI Pro

Box, envelope, band, and instructions for use

Material: PAP 22, PAP 21

Dispose of properly in paper recycling bins.

Urine Collection Set

Material: (PP) 05, (HDPE) 02, (PET) 01, (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in plastic recycling bins.

Alcohol swabs

Material: (Viscose/Cotton: not coded), (PP) 05, (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in residual waste bins. Packaging can be disposed of in plastic recycling bins.

Dry blood card

Material: (Cellulose Fiber: not coded), (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in residual waste bins. Packaging can be disposed of in plastic recycling bins.

Wound compress

Material: (Viscose: not coded), (PP) 05, (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in residual waste bins if unused or lightly soiled. If heavily soiled or contaminated with bodily fluids, dispose of in biohazard waste bins or according to local medical waste regulations. Packaging can be disposed of in plastic recycling bins.

Lancets

Material: (Stainless Steel: not coded), (PP) 05, (PE) 04

Dispose of properly in residual waste bins. Ensure that sharp objects like lancets, pen needles, and syringes are safely enclosed in sturdy containers (e.g., hard plastic or metal tins) before placing them in the trash, to prevent injury. Do not dispose of in recycling bins.
